svg.title: Balearic Current: SOCIB regional width range
svg.desc: Provider-reported 20 to 35 km along the northern Balearic island shelf. No representative midpoint, seasonal endpoint assignment, confidence interval or mapped width edges. Width calculation and sampling period unspecified.

g.text: Northern island shelf · SOCIB document version 13 November 2023
Range preserved; no midpoint selected. Width error and dates unknown.
Autumn maximum is qualitative variability, not a 35 km seasonal width.
Mean GV 0.2 m/s is not an edge cutoff. No geographic band inferred.
Source: Juza (2021), SOCIB Regional Estimates, version 2023-11-13, p5 · CC BY 4.0
Independent OSW graphic; original fields and row-specific boundary method not reproduced.
